title: Satlyt raises $8M seed round
summary: Kenyan-founded startup raises seed funding for software that lets satellites process data and run AI in orbit.

title: NigComSat selects Hughes JUPITER gateway for NigComSat-2A and 2B
summary: First public ground-segment contract on the NigComSat-2 programme: multi-band Ka/Ku/C gateway plus support for local terminal assembly.

title: Thales Alenia Space contracted to build NigComSat-2A
summary: Spacebus B2 GEO satellite of nearly 4 tonnes, coverage from West and Central Africa to Southern Africa, 15+ year life.

title: Nigeria approves NigComSat-2A and 2B; Thales Alenia Space and IAI selected
summary: Federal Executive Council approves two high-throughput satellites to replace NigComSat-1R; launches targeted for 2028 and 2029.

title: Amazon Leo partners with Herotel to launch satellite broadband in South Africa
summary: Amazon's first satellite internet agreement in Africa; consumer service planned for 2027.

title: Eutelsat signs multi-year LEO agreement with Mercury (Sonangol) in Angola
summary: Mercury will use Eutelsat OneWeb LEO services for public, private, offshore and telecom customers across Angola.

title: Amazon Kuiper Kenya applies for International Gateway Operator licence
summary: Gazette notice confirms a 15-year licence application for what would be Amazon Leo's first African gateway.

title: Uganda grants Starlink an operating licence
summary: Operational licence agreement signed between the regulator and Starlink, announced by President Museveni.

title: ICASA says Starlink-style equity alternatives need a change in law
parties: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
summary: Regulator states that recognising equity equivalent investment programmes would require amending the Electronic Communications Act.

title: Orange Tunisie launches nationwide satellite internet
summary: Service of up to 100 Mbps, following Orange's partnership with Eutelsat across Africa and the Middle East.

title: AXIAN Telecom (Yas) and AST SpaceMobile partner on direct-to-device network
summary: BlueBird satellites to be integrated with Yas core networks for voice, video and data straight to ordinary smartphones.

title: MTN Zambia completes Africa's first Starlink Direct to Cell field test
summary: First data session and fintech transaction over MTN spectrum and Starlink satellites; commercial launch subject to ZICTA approval.

title: Vodafone and Amazon Leo sign backhaul deal, with Africa rollout through Vodacom
summary: LEO backhaul for remote 4G/5G sites at up to 1 Gbps down, starting in Europe and then across Vodacom's African markets.

title: Amazon Leo and Vanu partner on rural mobile broadband in Africa
summary: Vanu's Coverage as a Service sites to use Amazon Leo satellite backhaul for 4G and 5G in underserved communities.

title: Seychelles approves Starlink licence
summary: Licence approved for 115 islands, with conditions.

title: Airtel Africa signs Starlink Direct to Cell deal for all 14 markets
summary: Satellite-to-phone service for Airtel's 174 million customers from 2026, subject to approval in each country.

title: Sonatel (Orange) launches satellite broadband in Senegal
summary: First unlimited satellite broadband offers for homes and businesses, using Eutelsat KONNECT.

title: MSTelcom (Sonangol) to distribute Eutelsat OneWeb in Angola
summary: Distribution for enterprise, public sector and telecom customers, including oil and gas and maritime; Eutelsat is Angola's only licensed LEO operator.

title: Eutelsat and Paratus sign multi-year OneWeb deal for Southern Africa
summary: Expanded LEO services for fixed sites, comms-on-the-move and comms-on-pause across five countries.

title: Thuraya enters South Africa with Thuraya-4 commercial rollout
summary: Thuraya's first operational entry into South Africa, targeting energy, mining, maritime, government and humanitarian users.

title: Rwanda and SpaceX plan first Starlink gateway in Rwanda
summary: Planned gateway to complement Starlink's Nigerian gateways and Nairobi point of presence.

title: Starlink secures operating licence in DR Congo
summary: Starlink's 22nd African market, after launches in Lesotho and Guinea-Bissau in April 2025.

title: Orange MEA and Eutelsat sign multi-year satellite broadband partnership
summary: Orange to use EUTELSAT KONNECT for up to 100 Mbps service, starting with Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, DRC and Jordan.

title: Starlink opens point of presence in Nairobi
summary: Regional routing node; reported latency for Kenyan users fell from 100–200 ms to about 30 ms.
